title: Culture and Social Organisation
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Ask learners about clans and age-sets in their families, without asking anyone to share private customs. Harmful practices (FGM, early marriage) are named plainly as harmful and against the law.

skills.key_step: The child tells age-groups from age-sets and gives the roles of each.

floor.prerequisite: Knows early forms of government included age-sets.
floor.question: What was an age-set?
floor.answer: a group initiated together with duties for their age

representations: a ladder: children, youth, adults, elders
age-set names from a community (teacher to supply)
steps: Say how an age-set was formed.

board.do: Draw a ladder of four steps.

board.say: Who is here, and what do they do?

board.do: Wait for elders who make decisions.
Write a role on each step.

listen_for: They were born in the same month
misconceptions.repair: Say age-group means the same stage of life; age-set means initiated together.

listen_for: Looking after the sick at home
misconceptions.ask: What was a main duty of the warrior age-set?
misconceptions.repair: Ask who guarded cattle and villages.

misconceptions.ask: What is the difference between an age-group and an age-set?
misconceptions.repair: Place cards: all the children of a village (age-group); boys initiated in one year (age-set).

misconceptions.ask: What did elders do in traditional societies?
misconceptions.repair: Act a council of elders hearing a case.

checks.question: What is an age-set?
checks.answer: a group of people initiated together who stay a group for life

checks.question: Give one duty of warriors in traditional society.
checks.answer: defending the community and its cattle

skills.key_step: The child says what a clan is and gives its functions.

floor.question: Who was in the same age-set?
floor.answer: people initiated at the same time

representations: a family tree back to one ancestor
steps: Draw the families from him or her.

board.do: Draw one ancestor with three family lines below.

board.say: What do we call all these families together?

misconceptions.ask: Who could a person marry in a clan system?
misconceptions.repair: Say clan members are like brothers and sisters.

listen_for: One family living in one home
misconceptions.repair: Draw one ancestor with many branches.

misconceptions.ask: Is a clan the same as the whole community?
misconceptions.repair: Draw a community circle with several clan circles inside.

misconceptions.ask: How did a clan help a family whose house burnt down?
misconceptions.repair: Tell a story of clan members helping after a fire.

checks.question: What is a clan?
checks.answer: a group of families from one ancestor

checks.question: Give one function of a clan.
checks.answer: any of: unity, guiding marriage, helping members, settling disputes, passing on culture

skills.key_step: The child sorts aspects of traditional culture into those to keep and those to stop, and says why.

floor.prerequisite: Gives the functions of a clan.
floor.question: Give one function of a clan.
floor.answer: any function such as helping members

representations: a music festival video or photo
steps: If not and it helps, keep it.
If it harms, stop it and say why.

board.say: Which practice harms girls and must stop?

board.do: Wait for FGM or early marriage.

misconceptions.ask: Which custom should NOT be preserved?
misconceptions.repair: Ask which customs help people and which harm them.
Ask what proverbs and folktales teach.

misconceptions.ask: A family plans to carry out FGM in secret. Is it acceptable?
misconceptions.repair: Say plainly that FGM harms girls and is against the law, and name who to tell.

misconceptions.ask: Should traditional songs and dances be kept?

checks.question: Give one aspect of traditional culture that should be kept.
checks.answer: any of: respect for elders, community work, hospitality, proverbs, songs, traditional foods, herbal knowledge

checks.question: Give one practice that should stop and why.
checks.answer: FGM or early marriage, because they harm children
